stem.text: What is the product of the reaction between compound Z and an excess of $\text{NaBH}_4$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: C=C retained, methyl branch, and two OH groups (one secondary, one primary)

B.alt: Skeletal formula: fully saturated chain with a methyl branch and two OH groups (one secondary, one primary)
